entities.name: Query serine hydroxymethyltransferase
observations: 418-aa query sequence has 58.5% identity and 96.9% query coverage to reviewed Dictyoglomus thermophilum serine hydroxymethyltransferase B5YDB7; sequence-based functional assignment is homology-supported.
Closest reviewed annotation identifies EC 2.1.2.1 serine hydroxymethyltransferase, with pyridoxal 5'-phosphate as cofactor.

entities.name: B5YDB7 SHMT
observations: Reviewed Dictyoglomus thermophilum serine hydroxymethyltransferase; EC 2.1.2.1; PLP-dependent enzyme.

entities.name: SHMT folate reaction
observations: Rhea RHEA:15481: (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + glycine + H2O = (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + L-serine; reversible serine hydroxymethyltransferase reaction.
